item.title: Council presses Coillte on dangerous roadside trees
item.description: By Avril Horan CALLS have been made for Coillte to carry out a full investigation into dangerous roadside trees across the county. Galway County Council has agreed a motion, proposed by Cllr Michael Regan (FF), requesting Coillte report back to the Council with the exact locations involved and a clear timeline for their removal.
